# Diversity Resources

> > Diversity Resources provides AI-powered belonging calendars, microlearning training, and DEI tools to help organizations build inclusive workplaces through cultural awareness and employee engagement.

Diversity Resources offers comprehensive diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) solutions centered on the Belonging Calendar—a microlearning platform that integrates with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. The company helps organizations recognize cultural observances, religious holidays, and heritage months while providing bite-sized training content and best practices for workplace inclusion.

## Reference Calendars & Events

- [Diversity Calendar 2026](https://www.diversityresources.com/diversity-calendar-2026): 2026 diversity calendar with DEI events, religious observances, heritage months.

- [Diversity Calendar 2025](https://www.diversityresources.com/diversity-calendar): 2025 diversity calendar with multicultural holidays, heritage months, events.

- [Awareness Months 2026](https://www.diversityresources.com/awareness-months): Reference guide to national awareness months and their associated colors.
